run_evaluation_generation: run the main hydra CLI to generate LLM-based evaluation propositions for navigation benchmark scenes
generate_plain_text_evaluations: generate plain text evaluation propositions for a single scene using LLMEvaluationGenerator
merge_scene_datasets: merge scene-specific datasets and metadata into a single combined dataset with new episode IDs
verify_episodes_in_simulator: verify that generated episodes can load and evaluate without crashing in the Habitat simulator
trim_failed_episodes: trim the merged dataset to only episodes that passed simulator verification
